name: L-V-Eval
intro: L-V-Eval是一个具有五个长度等级（16k至256k词）的长上下文基准。包含单跳和多跳问答两大任务，涉及11个双语数据集。通过插入混淆事实和关键词替换等技术，更客观地评估大型语言模型的长上下文处理能力。
org: Infinigence AI, Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong Univers
intro_en: L-V-Eval is a long-context benchmark with five length levels (16k to 256k tokens). It includes single-hop and multi-hop QA tasks across 11 bilingual datasets. Techniques like inserting distracting facts and keyword replacement are used to more objectively evaluate large language models' long-context processing abilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.05136. L-V-Eval builds 11 bilingual long-context QA datasets from public sources and fact-recall tasks, keeps the same QA pairs across five length levels from 16K to 256K words, mixes supporting documents with distractors, inserts GPT-4-generated and human-revised confusing facts, applies manually crafted keyword/phrase replacement rules to reduce knowledge leakage, annotates answer keywords and blacklists non-informative words, then uses a two-stage keyword-recall and F1/accuracy metric.
